# Fieldform Studio

> Fieldform Studio is an architecture and interiors practice in Portland,
> Oregon, founded 2011. Note: this site is a fictional portfolio demo.

## Pages

- index.html: home overview, selected work, practice philosophy
- projects.html: filterable grid of built projects
- project-ashgrove.html: Ashgrove House case study (residential, Hudson Valley, 2025)
- project-harborline.html: Harborline Pavilion case study (cultural, Portland ME, 2024)
- studio.html: people, history, values, recognition
- services.html: architecture, interiors, feasibility studies, master planning, FAQ
- journal.html: Field Notes essays (concrete use, small rooms, hero stairs, feasibility)
- contact.html: enquiry form and office details

## Studio facts

- 13-person practice, founded 2011
- Services: architecture, interior architecture, feasibility studies, master planning
- Engagement models: full service, design direction, advisory
- Office: 118 NW Flanders St, Suite 402, Portland OR 97209
- Takes on eight projects per year
